divergences.fix_hint: Compiled output at 0x10cbf0-0x10cc1e is all 0xFFFFFFFF (invalid) instead of a NOP; address mapping from 0x115626 to 0x10cbf0 is wrong, and the compiled binary contains uninitialized/erased memory.

concerns: Original disasm shows only a single NOP at 0x115626 — disassembler may have failed to decode the function body, or the function at 0x1155fc truly is just a NOP tail/sentinel.
Compiled region (0x10cbf0-0x10cc1e) is entirely 0xFFFFFFFF 'invalid' bytes, indicating the mechanical reconstruction was either not written to that region or was placed at a different base address.
Address delta between original (0x115xxx) and compiled (0x10cxxx) is ~0x8C0C — the mechanical generator is using an incorrect base address for the reconstructed function.

When raw bytes are read at 0x10cbf0 they contain valid ARM code from the original firmware (ldr r0,[r3] / ldr.w r3,[r0,0x264]), confirming the compiled reconstruction was never overlaid onto the firmware image — the comparison is meaningless until the base address and binary source are corrected.
